sloka: सो ऽभिवाद्य ततः पादौ वाल्मीकेः पुरुषर्षभः ।पाद्यमर्ध्यं तथातिथ्यं जग्राह मुनिहस्ततः ।। ७.७१.४ ॥
transliteration: so 'bhivādya tataḥ pādau vālmīkeḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ ।pādyamardhyaṁ tathātithyaṁ jagrāha munihastataḥ ।। 7.71.4 ॥

translations.english: Then, the best among men, Shatrughna, having saluted Valmiki's feet, accepted the water for washing feet, the respectful offering, and the hospitality from the sage's hand.
translations.hindi: राजा के वचन सुन कर, यदु ने नृपश्रेष्ठ ययाति से कहा-- तुम्हारा तो प्यारा पुत्र पूरु हे, बही तुम्हारा बुढ़ापा लेगा
